_noteP: P FOURTH SHOT (loop 479, user request). Whisper was uncurated entirely. Live wiki (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jhin, fetched 2026-08-21): the fourth shot of the four-round magazine is a guaranteed critical strike that deals BONUS physical damage equal to 15/20/25% (based on level) of the targets MISSING health, hard-capped at 800 vs monsters. That is the BIN calc FourthShotExecutePercent on JhinPassive, and it is a FRACTION, which is why it is curated through the new metHpPercentCalc field with hpBasis Missing rather than metCalc - a flat read would have contributed 0.15 damage instead of 15% of missing health. Shaped as an onHit rider on P rather than a hit on any ability slot, because it rides an AUTO ATTACK: it therefore offers its checkbox on the AA node, which is where the user decides which shot of the magazine this is. Gated on Upgraded and default OFF, so a plain auto is unchanged and an untouched node shows the [ordinary shot, fourth shot] span. The guaranteed crit is NOT modeled here - crit is the engines own CanCrit/crit-chance path and pinning it would double-count against a build that already carries crit chance; the monster cap is out of scope for a champion-target calculator.
_noteCritP: (2026-10-20, M45 loop 44) The fourth shot always critically strikes: its box now makes that attack crit for sure (guaranteedCritWhenMet), where it only added the missing-health bonus and the swing kept its expected crit. And Jhin's critical strikes deal CritReductionPercent (25%) less damage: every Jhin attack's crit multiplier x 0.75 (critReductionDataValue), expected or guaranteed - his crits read full before (the loop-485 note called it benign; it is a 25% over-count of every crit). Whether the live crit-damage stat already includes it is not public - applying it is the safe direction (HUMAN_CHECKLIST: a Practice Tool look).

_noteSweepTierA: SWEEP TIER-A ADJUDICATION (loop 485). FourthShotDamageMult (1.5) was the sweeps only remaining tier-A row - a damage-named DataValue no calc references. It is NOT an uncurated damage instance: it is Jhins REDUCED CRITICAL STRIKE multiplier. The live wiki (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jhin, fetched 2026-08-21) says his critical strikes deal 150% rather than the usual 200%, which is 75% of a normal crit, and the sibling DataValue CritReductionPercent 0.25 is the other half of that same statement. It therefore belongs to the M27 expected-crit scalar class already adjudicated benign for Akshan E, Samira Q and Senna P, not to the damage-hit schema. Recorded so the sweep stops surfacing it and so nobody curates a 1.5x hit that would double-count against the crit path.
